Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: Chinese Microsoft Edge Add-ons product feature image, landscape 1280 x 800 px (16:10). Deliver one finished raster image.
Primary request: polished Simplified Chinese promotional feature illustration for VideoTracker, a browser extension that remembers watch progress across supported video websites. This is clearly a feature illustration, not a claim to be an actual screenshot.
Style: precise editorial software marketing design, near-white background, dark navy typography, restrained indigo #4361ee accents and mint #20c997 progress lines; spacious, crisp Chinese sans-serif; strong typography, subtle card shadows, no loud gradients.
Composition: generous 60px safe margins. Small "VideoTracker" wordmark at top. Large headline on left in two lines "看到哪里，" "就从哪里继续". Under it: "自动记录观看进度，一键打开继续看". Under this a quiet text row "B站 · YouTube · 爱奇艺 · 腾讯视频".
On right a beautiful illustrative stack of three video record cards, no device mockup. Titles exactly "摄影入门：光线与构图", "周末旅行日志", "前端开发实战". Each has an original abstract thumbnail, platform text B站 / YouTube / 腾讯视频, a mint progress bar, and distinct readable times "12:34 / 28:00", "08:20 / 20:00", "25:10 / 45:00". A small illustrative cursor near first card communicates click to resume. Do not add fake buttons or unsupported features.
Bottom subtle pills: "自动记录" and "一键续播". Bottom-right small readable label "功能示意 · 示例数据".
Constraints: render every Chinese text exactly with correct glyphs. All text horizontal, no perspective, no tiny clutter, no unrelated branding or watermarks, no claimed user counts, no ratings, no mobile devices. Flat image edge to edge, high readability at store listing size.
